summary: Independent review of 7.9 chunk1 (53 units): 17 error issues, 39 minor issues, 84 machine patches (patch ops split one per issue entry), 4 hand edits. Tokens, flags 4/21/26/41 (all four accepted, suggestions right) and confidences are sound. Errors: (a) unit 25 elliptic clause read as its opposite; (b) unit 40 order of last items; (c) unit 45 vā misplaced and one 'or' added; (d) deviations from fixed renderings added by other Book 7 reviewers: lābha = gain (7.7, 7.10) not 'acquisition' (units 1,2,3,6,33,35,50,52,53); sama/viṣama/ati-sandhi = equal/unequal/outwitting treaty (7.7) not 'even/uneven' (4,5,6,7); pratāpa = splendour (7.4) not 'might' (18,26). Minor: unbracketed supplied copula in verbless clauses; kṛcchra = कठिनाई not संकट; 'रूप से' added for samuttha; 'duplicity' for advaidhya; '[verse]' in unit 37; Hindi सम-सन्धि hyphen; n./m. slips (40, 49); w endings (ubhayataḥ, anyataḥ); comma moved to wrong word in unit 12; bhogya = भोग्य (7.5). Drafter's doubts decided: praṇayāt kept 'affection' (set against artha; Book 5 'request' stays in Book 5); hiraṇya = money, bhoga = enjoyment (literal, 'in men/money/land' left, a person may prefer 'use'), daṇḍa = army in 29-30, yoga = connection (जुड़ाव), sampanna = excellent accepted. HAND EDITS (not patchable): unit 13 merge the two word entries of the '.' compound mahad.upakurvan into one (w mahat-upakurvan, gloss 'greatly helping'); unit 36 add text_flag alpa.prayasatā -> alpa.prayāsatā and set w to alpa-prayāsatā; unit 43 move word entry atha from token 'sambaddham' to token 'eka.arthena-atha'; unit 50 gloss of both lābhaḥ entries 'acquisition' -> 'gain'. No regrouping suggested.
